templates.title: Issue templates

mode.fillHint: The template becomes the description, ready to edit.
mode.placeholderHint: The template shows greyed out in the empty description and is not saved with the issue.

email.title: Email
email.subtitle: The SMTP server Sprint Boot sends invitations, password resets and notifications through.
email.sslHint: Turn on for port 465. On other ports the connection upgrades to TLS when the server offers it.
email.passwordKept: Saved. Leave blank to keep it.
email.testHint: Uses the saved settings, so save your changes first.

tokens.title: API & MCP tokens
tokens.apiHint: Let scripts and integrations call the REST API as you.
tokens.mcpHint: Let AI assistants work in Sprint Boot as you, through MCP tools.
tokens.createdHint: This is the only time the token is shown. Store it somewhere safe.
tokens.revokeBody: Anything using this token stops working right away.

clientHint.codex: Run both lines in a terminal, then open a new one so Codex sees {{variable}}. On macOS or Linux, use export {{variable}}=... in your shell profile instead of setx.
clientHint.copilot: Save as .vscode/mcp.json in your project, or add it to your user mcp.json, then start the server from the MCP view in VS Code.
clientHint.config: For Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json) and other clients that read an mcpServers file.

mcp.createdConnect: Add the server to your client with one of these. They already hold the new token.
mcp.title: MCP Documentation
mcp.intro: The Model Context Protocol lets AI assistants use tools. With an MCP token, an assistant can read and update your work in Sprint Boot, with exactly the permissions you have.
mcp.connectHint: Create an MCP token, then add this server to your client and replace YOUR_MCP_TOKEN.
mcp.toolsHint: Read tools work with every MCP token. Write tools need a token that is not read only.

tools.list_spaces: Lists the spaces you can see, with their keys.
tools.search_issues: Finds issues by text, optionally within one space.
tools.get_issue: Reads one issue with its description, comments and subtasks.
tools.list_transitions: Lists the statuses an issue can move to now.
tools.create_issue: Creates an issue in a space.
tools.update_issue: Changes the title or description of an issue.
tools.transition_issue: Moves an issue to another status, following its workflow.
tools.add_comment: Adds a comment to an issue.

mcp.securityBody: A token acts as you, so workflow rules and space permissions still apply. Keep tokens out of shared files, give each client its own, and revoke one as soon as it is no longer needed.

globalTemplates.title: Issue templates
globalTemplates.subtitle: Templates by issue type. Every space sees them under its type of the same kind and can use them. A change here reaches every space that uses the template.
globalTemplates.typeLocked: Spaces use this template, so its issue type cannot change.
globalTemplates.deleteUsed_one: {{count}} space template reuses it and will be deleted too. Issues already created from it keep their description.
globalTemplates.deleteUsed_other: {{count}} space templates reuse it and will be deleted too. Issues already created from them keep their description.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.empty: Ask about your issues: find them, summarize them, explain what they mean. Changes only happen after you confirm them.
assistant.emptyIssue: Ask about this issue. The assistant reads it, with its comments, before it answers.
assistant.question: Ask the assistant
assistant.refused: The model declined to answer this.
assistant.cutOff: The answer was cut off at the length limit.
assistant.deleteBody: The conversation is removed for good. Changes it made to issues stay.
assistant.unavailable: The assistant is switched off. An administrator can turn it on under Administration → AI assistant.

assistantAdmin.title: AI assistant
assistantAdmin.subtitle: Let people chat with an AI model about their issues. The assistant uses the default connection.
assistantAdmin.enabledHint: Everyone signed in can use it. It sees and changes only what each person may, and changes need their confirmation.
assistantAdmin.noConnection: Add a connection, or the assistant stays unavailable.
assistantAdmin.name: Name
assistantAdmin.baseUrlHint: The address of the chat completions API: https://api.openai.com/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, …
assistantAdmin.apiKeyOptional: Leave empty for servers that take no key
assistantAdmin.modelsLoaded_one: {{count}} model loaded. Pick one from the Model field.
assistantAdmin.modelsLoaded_other: {{count}} models loaded. Pick one from the Model field.
assistantAdmin.noModels: The provider returned no models. Type the model name.
assistantAdmin.deleteBody: If it is the default, another connection becomes the default.
assistantAdmin.privacy: Questions, and the issues the assistant reads to answer them, are sent to the provider of the default connection.
